call_points.text: FY27 volume growth maintained at high single-digit to low double-digit for the combined business.
Consolidated EBITDA margin target of 16%-18% by FY29, with upward bias.
90% of the Imperial Blue business transitioned to Tilaknagar units; last state expected by March 2027.
Highest ever monthly volume of 3.4 million cases in June 2026; Imperial Blue largest selling Deluxe Whisky.
Imperial Blue reintroduced in Delhi in July 2026; peak volume was 0.5 million cases, expected within 12-18 months.
Packaging inflation, particularly glass, pressured gross margin to 42.1% adjusted, from 45.2% in Q4FY26.
Telangana price increase expected soon, with 150-200 bps annualised margin impact.
Term debt of ~₹2,000 Cr structured with 80% repayments in years 5 and 6 and a 2-year moratorium.
Management flagged inflation as the key risk, mitigated by price increases in various states and supply chain optimisation.
Bartisans stake increased from 36.2% to 41.5% during the quarter.
Prag distillery capacity in Andhra Pradesh expanded from 6 lakh cases to 36 lakh cases per annum.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Reassessment proceedings u/s 147 were conducted following a search action on the company in February 2024 and order was passed u/s 143(3) / 147 r.w.s. 143(3) for AY 2016-17 to AY 2024-25. In the orders, certains additions / disallowances were made by the Assessing Officer (AO) and the same was adjusted against the carry forward losses of the company. The year wise demand/refund and the consequent carry forward losses of Rs 32.79 crores as on March 31, 2024, is mentioned in our intimation letter dated Feb 1, 2025 & March 29, 2025. Being aggrieved by the said order, the company has filed an appeal before the CIT(A). In the “date of initiation of the litigation/dispute” we have mentioned the date of appeal filing before the Commissioner (Appeals) for AY 2016-17 to AY 2023-24. For AY 2024-25, the date of appeal file is March 28,2025.
tax_litigation.status: Appeals were filed before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals), challenging the additions / disallowances made by the Income Tax Department. The company made submissions on time-to-time basis during various hearings. The CIT(A) heard the matter and passed an order partially in favor of the company for AY 2016-17 to AY 2024-25 on March 31,2026.

operating_notes.text: House of TI luxury portfolio won four awards at the London Spirits Competition in April 2026.
Prag Distillery capacity expanded six-fold to 36 lakh cases per annum in Andhra Pradesh with a ₹59 crore investment.
Acquisition of Imperial Blue business division completed on December 01, 2025 for a lump-sum cash consideration of Rs. 3,442 crores.
Board approved amalgamation of wholly-owned subsidiaries Punjabexpo Breweries and Vahni Distilleries with Tilaknagar Industries with an appointed date of April 1, 2026.
Mansion House Brandy surpassed 10 million cases in sales in FY26.
Prag distillery capacity expanded from 6 lakh cases per annum to 36 lakh cases per annum with ₹59 crore investment, expected to save ₹10 crore per annum in bottling costs.
Overall NSR per case was ₹1,183 in Q1FY27, up 1.5% QoQ and 5.3% YoY.
Imperial Blue volume was 5.4 million cases in Q1FY27, up 18% QoQ; full-year volume expected to grow double-digit from ~21.5 million cases at acquisition.
Prag Distillery bottling savings: 60%-70% of the expected ~₹100 million annual savings already reflected in Q1FY27.
DRI initiated search proceedings at corporate office and Ahilyanagar facility regarding bulk Scotch HSN code review.

timeline.summary: Tilaknagar Industries' luxury portfolio won four awards at the London Spirits Competition, announced on April 24, 2026.
Tilaknagar Industries' subsidiary Prag Distillery received government approval to commence production at its expanded AP facility.
Tilaknagar Industries disclosed the monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹2,093.07 crore utilized from preferential issue proceeds.
Tilaknagar Industries board approved the amalgamation of wholly owned subsidiaries Punjabexpo Breweries and Vahni Distilleries on May 29, 2026.
Tilaknagar Industries reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹949 crore with a volume of 8.0 million cases.
Tilaknagar Industries Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4 & FY26 results conference call on May 30, 2026, available at www.tilind.com.
Tilaknagar Industries held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 30, 2026, reporting net revenue of ₹949 Cr.

On 4 August 2026, Tilaknagar Industries filed the transcript of its Q1FY27 earnings call, where management reported 166% YoY revenue growth to ₹1,046 Cr, 90% Imperial Blue integration, and a net debt reduction target of ~₹1,700 Cr by March 2027.

On October 23, 2026, Tilaknagar Industries disclosed that the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence initiated search operations at its corporate office and Ahilyanagar facility regarding an industry-wide bulk Scotch HSN review.
